test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The suspects had to go through ______ parade so that the real culprit could be caught.
solution:
The correct answer is **'an identification'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank falls under the independent clause in the given sentence - *The suspects had to go through ______ parade *
 
• In the clause, we have the **subject (suspects)** and the **verb (had to go). **
 
• But the **clause is missing an object. **
 
• Objects are typically **noun phrases **(a noun or pronoun and any dependent words before or after it).
 
• From the given options only **identification **is a **noun **which means the action or process of identifying someone or something or the fact of being identified.
 
• So, the correct phrase for the given blank is **an identification.**
 
• Hence, **option 3 **is the correct answer. 

***Correct sentence - ****The suspects had to go through **an identification **parade so that the real culprit could be caught.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Identified **is the past tense form of the verb identify.
 
• **Identify **is a verb. *A identify **is an incorrect phrase.***
